subject: maths
question: Sumit earned Rs. 10,692 as simple interest on Rs. 29,700 at a certain rate of interest for 3 years. His friend Anil invested Rs. 12,500 for 2 years at the same rate of interest but on compound interest compounded annually. How much did Anil earn as interest?
solution:
Formula:

P = SI×100over R× T

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P

where-

P = Principal, SI = Simple Interest

R = Rate, T = Time

CI = Compound Interest, A = Amount

Calculation:

Using the SI formula, we get-

10,692 = 29700×Rtimes 3over100 

⇒ R = 10,692 times 100over29700 times 3 = 12%

Amount accrued to Anil, when invested at compound Interest,

⇒ 12,500 × (1 + 12over 100)2

Total amount = Rs 15,680

CI = Rs 15,680 - Rs 12,500 = Rs 3,180

∴ The compound interest on the sum is Rs 3,180.
